glosses: behaviour (the way matter moves or acts)
press that specializes in social habits, whether related to consumption, food, fashion, family, entertainment, travel, or any other area

examples.en: Tom needs to change his behavior.

examples.text: Não há desculpa para seu mau comportamento.
examples.en: There's no excuse for his bad behavior.

examples.text: Esse tipo de comportamento é inaceitável.
examples.en: That kind of behavior is unacceptable.

examples.text: Eu estou cheio do seu comportamento.
examples.en: I'm fed up with your behavior.
